description:
Umbrella for the admin UI feature.  Implementation plan: docs/admin-ui/IMPL-admin-ui.md.  Spec: docs/admin-ui/BRD-admin-ui.md (data) and docs/admin-ui/BRD-admin-ui-design.md (design).

Hard ordering rule: 03c0d49e (Caddy) and 6cedb4d0 (auth gate) land before any data-rendering child.  Skipping ahead means the placeholder admin page is briefly internet-reachable.

Closes when all seven children close.

resolution.note:
All 7 subtasks complete. Read-only admin observability layer ships:

- Tailnet ingress (Caddy listener split + cert renewal timer)
- Auth gate (requireAdmin + middleware + admin route group + /admin-404)
- Migration 008 admin indexes
- Overview dashboard (stat tiles + sparklines + top-10s)
- Users list + deep dive (DataTable + FilterPills + BudgetBar + CSV)
- Session + Query deep dives (ExpandableQuery + per-query model_pricing)
- Operational hygiene (full admin runbook in deploy/README.md)

Post-merge operator actions: copy Caddyfile + units to VPS, install
timer, set ADMIN_USER_IDS in /etc/guru-web.env, restart guru-web.
Sequence in the new 'Admin UI runbook' section.
